title: 第1304章 一万亿vs五百五十万亿第1303章 巧舌如簧的魔族统领四界联手
slug: 付费才能修仙我的宗门全免费
content_zh:
一万亿对四界联军，超过五百五十万亿大军！
其中还有魔界这样的强大军团！
这是何等悬殊的差距！
之前人界一万亿对天庭三百万亿，已经创造了亘古未有的奇迹。
可此刻，他们面对的是四界联军！
神界、妖界、鬼界、魔界，四大永恒界的精锐大军！
尤其是魔界那两百二十万亿大军，每一尊都是从尸山血海中杀出来的蛊王！
这已经不是悬殊了。
这是令人窒息的绝望！
仙界那三百万亿大军，面对这样的对手，只会顷刻间溃败，毫无还手之力！
人间界阵营后方，血月老祖那张老脸上的欣慰早已消失不见，取而代之的是一种深深的忧虑。
“四界联手，五百五十万亿大军......”
他的声音中满是压抑不住的颤抖。
“圣皇大人，人界弟子们......能撑得住吗？”
黄金族老祖更是双拳紧攥，指节都因用力过度而发白。
“魔界那两百二十万亿大军才是最大的威胁！”
“之前在帝路争锋中，魔界低境界战场的胜率可是高达九成！”
“它们的单兵战力实在太强了！比起天庭那帮废物，简直不是一个层次的！”
“更何况，其他三界也不是省油的灯，神族的审判之阵、妖界的万妖大阵、鬼界的噬魂大阵，哪一样不是威震诸天的杀招？”
冰神站在原地，那张绝美的面容上也浮现出了一抹凝重。

“四界联手，比天庭那三百万亿更难对付十倍百倍！”
“天庭的大军虽然人多，可论单兵战力，大多数都是些养尊处优的废物。”
“可魔界每一个都是从尸山血海里杀出来的，战斗本能刻在骨头里，悍不畏死，极难对付。”
剑主点了点头，那双深邃的眼眸中闪过一丝担忧。
“更何况，其他三界虽然单兵战力不如魔界，可各有底牌，如果他们轮番消耗人界弟子，后果不堪设想。”
而远古战场的另一边，魔界阵营、妖界阵营、鬼界阵营、神族阵营的强者们，此刻全都露出了看好戏的神色。
甚至，消失了几十年的仙界强者，此刻也出现了，来看好戏。
“四界联手，人界再强也得跪！”
“之前赢我们不过是运气好罢了，真当自己能逆天了？”
“一万亿对五百五十万亿，这仗还用打吗？”
“桀桀，本座倒要看看，人界那些弟子还能蹦跶多久！”
“神枪圣皇就算再强又如何？他又上不了第一重天战场！到时候我们避他锋芒就行！”
“这一战，人界必败！”
content_en:
One trillion versus the Allied Forces of the Four Realms, an army of more than 550 trillion!
Among them are powerful legions like the Demon Realm!
What a disparity!
Previously, one trillion in the human world and three hundred billion in the heaven had created an unprecedented miracle.
But at this moment, they are facing the coalition forces from the four realms!
God Realm, Demon Realm, Ghost Realm, Demon Realm, the elite armies of the four eternal realms!
Especially the two hundred and twenty trillion army in the demon world, each one is a Gu King killed from the mountain of corpses and sea of ​​blood!
This is no longer a disparity.
This is suffocating despair!
Facing such an opponent, the 300 billion army in the immortal world will be defeated in an instant, without the ability to fight back!
Behind the camp in the human world, the joy on the old face of the Blood Moon Patriarch had long since disappeared, replaced by a deep worry.
"The four realms join forces, an army of 550 trillion..."
His voice was filled with uncontrollable trembling.
"Lord Holy Emperor, the disciples of the human world...can they hold on?"
The ancestor of the Golden Tribe clenched his fists tightly, and his knuckles turned white from excessive exertion.
"The two hundred and twenty trillion army in the demon world is the biggest threat!"
"In the previous battle for the Imperial Road, the winning rate on the low-level battlefield in the Demon Realm was as high as 90%!"
"Their individual combat power is so strong! Compared to that bunch of trash in Heaven, they are simply not on the same level!"
"What's more, the other three realms are not fuel-efficient lamps. The Judgment Formation of the Gods, the Ten Thousand Demons Formation of the Demon Realm, and the Soul-Eating Formation of the Ghost Realm, which one is not a killing move that shocks the heavens?"
The Ice God stood there, with a hint of solemnity appearing on his beautiful face.
"The four realms join forces and are ten times and a hundred times more difficult to deal with than the three hundred billion in Heaven!"
"Although there are many people in Heaven's army, in terms of individual combat capabilities, most of them are just pampered trash."
"But everyone in the demon world is killed from the mountains of corpses and seas of blood. Their fighting instincts are engraved in their bones. They are not afraid of death and are extremely difficult to deal with."
The sword master nodded, a trace of worry flashing in his deep eyes.
"What's more, although the individual combat power of the other three realms is not as good as that of the Demon Realm, they each have their own trump cards. If they take turns consuming the disciples of the Human Realm, the consequences will be disastrous."
On the other side of the ancient battlefield, the strong men from the Demon Realm camp, the Demon Realm camp, the Ghost Realm camp, and the God Clan camp all looked like they were watching the show.
Even powerful men from the fairy world who had disappeared for decades appeared at this moment to watch the show.
"The four realms join forces, no matter how strong the human realm is, it will have to kneel down!"
"Before, we were just lucky to win against us. Do you really think you can defy the odds?"
"One trillion versus 550 trillion, is there still a need to fight this battle?"
"Jie Jie, I want to see how long those disciples in the human world can keep jumping around!"
"So what if the Divine Spear Emperor is stronger? He can't go to the first battlefield! When the time comes, we can just avoid his edge!"
"In this battle, the human world will be defeated!"
